reader.requirement: At --std 85 a CLOSE of a report file (one with a REPORT clause) is executed only for a file in an open mode; a CLOSE of a report file not in an open mode (never opened, already closed, after an unsuccessful OPEN, or after CLOSE WITH NO REWIND/LOCK) is unsuccessful with I-O status 42 (VII.1.3.5 4b, via GR4) and performs no closing action. This holds for every CLOSE format the Report Writer allows (plain, REEL/UNIT [FOR REMOVAL], WITH NO REWIND, WITH LOCK).
reader.edition-search: Grepped Edition|DialectBehavior|CobolVersion in SequentialIoBinder.BindClose, SequentialIoEmitter.EmitClose, FileRegistry.CloseByFormat/CloseCell and FileConnector.Close: the not-open guard (CloseCell's `if (!c.IsOpen)` and the CloseUnit arm's `!c.IsOpen ? FileNotOpen`) reads no edition. The only edition read near it is CloseWithLock's DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector, which runs only after a successful close and is not part of this rule.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb140_close_status uses an ordinary sequential file, not a report file; the report-file CLOSE on a never-opened file, after a failed OPEN, and the REEL/LOCK/NO REWIND forms on a closed report file are covered only by probes here

after an unsuccessful OPEN EXTEND the report file is not in an open mode, so CLOSE gives 42

reader.notes: A report file registers as a SequentialConnector (FileRegistry.RegisterReport), so it takes the one CLOSE dispatch; the not-open guard is hoisted ahead of every Table 14 symbol and sets 42 with no closing action. Every not-open form probed answers 42 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-040/r1decl.cob (--std 85, a report file with NO FILE STATUS and a USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR PROCEDURE ON PRT): a CLOSE of the never-opened report file, then CLOSE WITH NO REWIND, CLOSE REEL and CLOSE UNIT FOR REMOVAL of the file after a CLOSE WITH LOCK each ran the declarative (DECL-RAN 1, 2, 3, 4; COUNT=4) and execution continued, so the not-open guard reaches every Table 1 format and the 42 drives the USE procedure the same as a FILE STATUS item; the successful CLOSE WITH LOCK did not run it. Probe r5idx.cob: CLOSE after a failed OPEN EXTEND (39) answered 42. The reader's p1close covers FILE STATUS. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.2.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK §1985:VII.1.3.5 (status 07 in GRL2.1d; the 42 line is the reader's checked GRL2.4b).
